cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*\siri\tools\worker.py*' }; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('killing pid ' + $_.ProcessId + ' ' + $_.CommandLine); Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force } } else { Write-Output 'siri worker not running' }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*worker.py*' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('still running: ' + $_.ProcessId + ' ' + $_.CommandLine) }"
